cwAlerts.hintSignIn: Sign in to get these as push notifications — even with the app closed.
cwAlerts.hintProfileOff: Price-alert notifications are turned off in your profile, so these won't push to your phone.
cwAlerts.hintDeviceOff: Notifications are off on this device, so these alerts can't reach you.
cwAlerts.hintOn: You'll get a push notification when price crosses the level — even with the app closed or killed. Tap a set alert to cancel it.
